questions.de: Wem gehörte der 1964er Chevrolet Chevelle Malibu, den Vincent Vega im Film Pulp Fiction fährt?
questions.en: Who owned the 1964 Chevrolet Chevelle Malibu that Vincent Vega drives in the film Pulp Fiction?

timeline.labelEn: Quentin Tarantino's 1964 Chevelle Malibu from Pulp Fiction is reported stolen
timeline.labelDe: Quentin Tarantinos 1964er Chevelle Malibu aus Pulp Fiction wird als gestohlen gemeldet

source.title: Stolen 'Pulp Fiction' car found 19 years later

questions.notes: The car was the director's own; stolen in 1994, it was recovered in 2013 in the Oakland area with a cloned VIN. Within the story the car is Vincent's own; the question means the real-life owner.

questions.notes: Card statement is false: Gorch Fock was the pen name of the writer Johann Wilhelm Kinau, not a seafarer who discovered Madagascar.
